slot.brief: Solve a homogeneous differential equation dy/dx = f(x,y) with degree-1 RHS using the substitution y = vx and integrate

stem: The general solution of $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x^2+y^2}{xy}$, for $xy\ne0$, is

verdicts.working: Set z=y/x. Then y'=z+xz', so xz'=1/z. Integrating gives z²−2ln|x|=C, i.e. y²/x²−2ln|x|=C (B).

working:
Put $y=vx$: $v+x\dfrac{dv}{dx}=v+\dfrac{1}{v}$
$v\,dv=\dfrac{dx}{x}$
$\dfrac{v^2}{2}=\ln|x|+C$
$\dfrac{y^2}{x^2}-2\ln|x|=C$

Independent check: Set z=y/x. Then y'=z+xz', so xz'=1/z. Integrating gives z²−2ln|x|=C, i.e. y²/x²−2ln|x|=C (B).
